# Golden-set fixtures

Text excerpts reconstructed from the sources seen in the 2026-10-08 production runs (Tesla,
SpaceXSI), trimmed to the passages that triggered the bugs. Sentences that were quoted in those
runs are kept verbatim; surrounding filler and any figure not quoted in a run are synthetic test
values (do not cite them). The fake LLM replies in tests/test_golden.py replay what the model
proposed in those runs (storage as energy, bond and turbine deals as capex, dot-leader and
parenthesized table rows, inconsistent entity).
